notes: Release date 2026-07-06 printed on the official blog page (JS-rendered SPA; rendered via headless browser; OpenRouter tencent/hy3 created 2026-07-06 matches). Open-sourced under Apache 2.0 on GitHub/HuggingFace/ModelScope/AtomGit. Page prose gives MRCR 75.1% (from 42.9% on Hy3 preview) as DOM text — verified; the appendix 模型得分 table renders as one image, so its 40 rows are vision-assisted reads kept pending with values recorded per-row in notes. Appendix note verbatim (translated): reasoning effort highest tier for all models; results with * are from our own testing (competitor columns not transcribed as rows). Internal in-house benchmarks (Hy-Backend 2.0, Hy-SWE Max, Hy-CompanyBench, e-bench, Hy-FinModelBench, ProdBench, Hy-SkillsWorld, Hy-Euler pro, Hy-Math) are vendor-owned. Also disclosed in prose: cross-scaffold SWE Bench Verified std within 4pp across Codebuddy/Cline/KiloCode; internal 270-expert blind test Hy3 2.67/4 vs GLM5.1 2.51/4; hallucination rate 12.5%→5.4% and common-sense error rate 25.4%→12.7% vs preview (internal product evals, notes only). API price 1/4/0.25 CNY per M tokens.
